vo: Welcome to The Training Notebook One.
Thanks for your patience while we moved your account.
Here's how to invite your clients.
Open your client, then the profile tab.
Check their email. If it's wrong, tap edit details to fix it.
Tap the three dots, then send invite.
The invite is on its way.
Then, I was invited by my trainer.
They sign up with the email you have for them.
They type it in and tap confirm.
That's it. Their workouts are ready.
If you need more help, just reply to this email.
